text.p: Rabobank Investment Ltd started coverage of Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt with a 'buy' recommendation, saying the company will offer growth opportunities in coming years.
"Zalakeramia offers exciting growth opportunities within the next one to two years," said analyst Anthony Vago in a report.
"At current valuation levels we believe that the company is undervalued with respect to comparable companies and recommend buying the stock," he said.
The analyst expected Zalakeramia's earnings per share to amount to 517.4 forints in 1997 and 689.5 forints in 1998.

Vago said Zalakeramia was well placed on a market, characterised by overcapacity, as a low cost producer, whose recent acquisitions will enable it to offer a wider product range and give it an opportunity to export into neighbouring countries.
Zalakeramia bought majority stakes in Croatian ceramics firm Inker, Hungary's tile maker Inker and Romanian tile and sanitary products maker Cesarom this year.
Although the performance of Pietra and Inker will weigh down Zalakeramia's profitability in the short-term, this will be countered by Cesarom's performance, he said.
Rabo Investment Ltd is the securities arm of Rabobank Hungaria, which is a unit of Rabobank Nederland.
